description: Header Visibility on Dashboard Pages - Make the marketing site header visible on all dashboard pages while preserving the existing sidebar navigation for consistent branding and navigation experience.

userStories.title: Import marketing header into dashboard layout
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to integrate the marketing header component into the dashboard layout so it appears above the existing sidebar/content structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Marketing header component is imported in dashboard layout (src/app/[locale]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx)
Header renders above the existing flex container (sidebar + content)
Header maintains sticky positioning (sticky top-0 z-50)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Added Header import and rendered above sidebar/content container with sticky wrapper.

userStories.title: Adjust dashboard layout for header height
userStories.description: As a user, I want the dashboard content to be properly positioned below the header so nothing is hidden or overlapping.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard flex container accounts for header height using calc(100vh - 64px) or equivalent
Sidebar starts below the header (not behind it)
Main content area is fully visible without overlap
Scrolling behavior works correctly (header stays fixed, content scrolls)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: navigate to /fr/dashboard and confirm no content is hidden behind header
userStories.notes: Applied h-[calc(100vh-64px)] to content container. Sidebar and main content use h-full.

userStories.title: Add active state to Dashboard link in header
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the Dashboard navigation link highlighted when I'm on any dashboard page so I know where I am in the site.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard link in header shows active state styling when pathname starts with /[locale]/dashboard
Active state uses visual differentiation (text-teal-600 or similar)
Other navigation links (Tools, Pricing) show default inactive state when on dashboard
Active state logic uses usePathname() to detect current route
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: navigate between dashboard and marketing pages, confirm correct highlight state
userStories.notes: Added usePathname hook and isDashboardActive detection. Applied text-teal-600 styling for desktop and mobile nav.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate dashboard header
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove or hide the existing minimal dashboard header's user menu since the marketing header now provides auth controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing DashboardHeader component is removed from dashboard layout
No duplicate user account dropdowns on the page
Single source of auth controls (marketing header's account dropdown)
Logout functionality works from the marketing header on dashboard pages
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: confirm only one user menu exists, test logout
userStories.notes: Removed DashboardHeader import and usage from layout. Removed unused profile query.

userStories.title: Ensure sidebar and header coexist without conflict
userStories.description: As a user, I want both the header and sidebar to be usable without visual or functional conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar remains at full height below the header
Sidebar navigation items are all accessible and clickable
No z-index conflicts between header and sidebar
Print styles still hide both header and sidebar (print:hidden)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: test clicking sidebar links while header is visible
userStories.notes: Verified: sidebar has h-full, header has z-50, both have print:hidden. No conflicts.

userStories.title: Mobile header behavior on dashboard
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the hamburger menu to work on dashboard pages so I can access navigation on small screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Hamburger menu icon appears on mobile viewport (< 768px)
Tapping hamburger opens mobile navigation menu
Mobile menu includes all navigation links (Dashboard, Tools, Pricing)
Mobile menu includes language switcher
Mobile menu includes auth controls (account dropdown)
Menu closes when a link is tapped
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: resize to mobile width, test hamburger menu functionality
userStories.notes: Verified: Mobile menu fully functional with hamburger toggle, nav links, language switcher, and auth controls.
